name: General Mills
outlook:
What General Mills says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: organic net salesOrganic net sales are expected to range between down 1.5 percent and up 0.5 percent.
  • Fiscal 2027: adjusted operating profitAdjusted operating profit is expected to be down 13 percent to down 8 percent in constant currency.
  • Fiscal 2027: adjusted diluted earnings per shareAdjusted diluted earnings are expected to be between $3.00 and $3.20 per share.
  • Fiscal 2027: free cash flow conversionFree cash flow conversion is expected to be approximately 95 percent of adjusted after-tax earnings.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed September 23, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
